meaning: A nonhomogeneous spatial metric mode can couple only through the actual degree-one background derivatives and Noether current.  This is not a Lambda85 propagator and requires the parent gauge-fixed metric operator.
mixed_formula: sqrt(g) w gamma^{mu nu}[F'' Y A_mu_nu + F' deltaA_mu_nu - (1/2)F'Y g_mu_nu]
phase_formula: sqrt(g) w gamma^{mu nu}[2F''(j.dphi)A_mu_nu + 2F'j_(mu dphi_nu) - F'g_mu_nu(j.dphi)]
